Act of Information Processing (cco:ont00000366): this act documents root causes and the corrective/preventive actions taken and closes the Descriptive bpo:NonconformanceRecord; the actual remediation (enacting the CAPA) is modeled separately as the Implementation act 13.3.3.4 (bpo:P17496). The bpo:CorrectiveAndPreventiveActionSpecification is the governing has-input, not a fresh output.

Anchored to cco:ont00000366 (Act of Information Processing): this is a pure compiling/recording act -- it documents root causes and CAPA into, and closes, the nonconformance record. It is NOT reporting/communication (cco:ont00000379/151), since no dissemination to an audience is definitional, and NOT formulation, since no new Directive is authored: the governing bpo:CorrectiveAndPreventiveActionSpecification (Directive) is the has-INPUT being documented, and the has-output bpo:NonconformanceRecord is Descriptive, preserving info-processing -> descriptive agreement (GOLDEN PRINCIPLE).
